findings.title: SQL injection in GET /users via the name query parameter
findings.summary: The name query parameter is concatenated into a SQL string and executed, so an unauthenticated caller can read every user's email.

locations.quote: db.query("SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'")

findings.remediation: Pass name as a bound parameter: db.query('SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE name = $1', [name]).

findings.title: Possible path traversal in GET /files/:name
findings.summary: req.params.name is joined to the uploads directory without containment, but whether encoded slashes reach the handler depends on the deployed router and proxy.
findings.blocker: Whether the production proxy decodes %2F in path segments before routing.
